cases.question: German AX-17 guidance before latest revision?
cases.answer:
Historical view: documents in effect on 2026-09-14.

The superseded German AX-17 guidance, in effect from 2025-02-03 to 2026-09-15, is historical [E1, E2]. The historical starting dose was 50 mg OD for the Normal renal category [E1], 50 mg OD for the Mild renal category [E1], 50 mg OD for the Moderate renal category [E1], and not recommended for the Severe renal category [E1].

Sources
[E1] DE-AX17-LBL-038 · DE AX17 Superseded Label v3.8 · SUPERSEDED · effective 2025-02-03 · p.6, Historical renal dosing
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Superseded_Label_v3.8.pdf#page=6
[E2] DE-AX17-LBL-038 · DE AX17 Superseded Label v3.8 · SUPERSEDED · effective 2025-02-03 · p.1–3
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Superseded_Label_v3.8.pdf#page=1

Current version: DE-AX17-LBL-042 (DE AX17 Current Label v4.2), in effect since 2026-09-15. Ask for the current guidance to see it.

cases.question: What did the German label say before the September 2026 revision?
cases.answer:
Part 1
Historical view: documents in effect on 2026-09-30.

I don't have this in the controlled documents (the content of the German label before the September 2026 revision (DE-AX17-LBL-038)). The documents cover AX-17 labels, safety bulletins, clinical studies and safety letters for Germany, Singapore, UAE, United States. Say "route it" and I'll pass the question to Medical Information.

Part 2
The superseded German label (in effect from 2025-02-03 to 2026-09-15) stated the historical starting doses for renal impairment categories as follows: Normal was 50 mg OD, Mild was 50 mg OD, Moderate was 50 mg once daily (or 50 mg OD), and Severe was not recommended [E1, E2, E3].

Sources
[E1] DE-AX17-LBL-038 · DE AX17 Superseded Label v3.8 · SUPERSEDED · effective 2025-02-03 · p.1–3
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Superseded_Label_v3.8.pdf#page=1
[E2] DE-AX17-LBL-038 · DE AX17 Superseded Label v3.8 · SUPERSEDED · effective 2025-02-03 · p.6, Historical renal dosing
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Superseded_Label_v3.8.pdf#page=6
[E3] DE-AX17-LBL-038 · register facts (controlled document register, `documents` table)

Current version: DE-AX17-LBL-042 (DE AX17 Current Label v4.2), in effect since 2026-09-15. Ask for the current guidance to see it.
